layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records
Add integration test for denied exports

graderOnly: In src/export.ts the POST /records/export handler calls writeExport at line 72, which creates the export folder and writes the CSV of the filtered records, and only calls requireAdmin(request.user) at line 80, so authorization runs after the protected file is written.

A request with no user returns 401 and a viewer or editor request returns 403, but in each case the CSV file has already been written to the export folder; this violates AC-002 (denied before any export file is created) and the design's rule that requireAdmin is the handler's first step.

Tester's test 'export requests without an administrator are denied' in test/integration/export-flow.test.ts asserts only the status codes (401, 403, 403); it never checks that no export folder or file was created, so it passes against the defective handler, and the verification report marks AC-002 Verified on that evidence alone.
Developer's DEV-003 expected outcome claims denial before any folder or file is created; its self-checks never sent a non-admin or anonymous request.
AC-001 behavior for administrators (filtering, RFC 4180 quoting, headers, body equal to the file) is correct.
The correct immediate route is an IMPLEMENTATION failure to DEVELOPING for the handler order, with the Tester-owned assertion gap (VERIFICATION) also persisted in the review report so it is not lost.

notes: Built on export-project (the pre-install records service plus the brownfield install) rather than the suggested export-reviewing-impl, whose committed implementation authorizes first and whose Tester test already checks that no folder is created; history cannot be rewritten in an overlay. Eight commits recreate the export cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 in brownfield order: 50 context (Auditor CONTEXT.md, STATE SCOPING), 52 scope (AC-001 CSV export with RFC 4180 quoting; AC-002 non-admin or anonymous export denied by server-side authorization before any export file is created; STATE ARCHITECTING), 54 design (POST /records/export in a single module src/export.ts, requireAdmin as the handler's first step, x-record-count header; STATE DEVELOPING), 56 plan (APPROVED, three PENDING steps), 58 implementation (src/export.ts with serialization, file writing, and registerExportRoutes; createApp options; test/export.test.ts with five unit tests; admin-only integration test; test:integration script; exports/ ignored). In src/export.ts the handler calls writeExport at line 72 and requireAdmin at line 80. 60 marks the plan COMPLETE with self-checks citing the implementation commit (no non-admin request executed) and STATE TESTING. 62 is Tester's added integration test that sends anonymous, viewer, and editor requests and asserts only status codes. 64 is Tester's COMPLETE FULL verification record (AC-002 marked Verified from the status codes) and STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with FORWARD from TESTING.
